payload.name: Capture explicitly stated reasons as separate preference memories
payload.description: During construction extraction, when a speaker explicitly states a value, preference, or reason that motivates an action (e.g., '...is important to me, so I...'), apply this to extract that stated motivation as its own memory in addition to the action.
content: When extracting candidates from a message, if the speaker explicitly states a reason, value, or motivation for an action (e.g., 'Exercise and nature are important to me, so I...'), create a separate memory for that stated preference (memory kind 'preference' or 'profile') in addition to the event/activity memory; do not let the reason be dropped from the candidate set.
If the event/activity is being added to an existing memory, still capture the stated reason in its own preference/profile memory rather than burying it in the event text.
Only extract reasons explicitly stated in the message; do not infer or add motivations that the speaker did not say.

solves: General failure: extraction captures only the observable action and drops the explicitly stated value or reason ('X is important to me, so I do Y'), so later recall cannot answer why. Applies when a future message explicitly links a value/preference to an action and that stated reason is missing from memory. Does not apply when the reason is merely inferred, or when a preference/profile memory already records the stated reason.
